app.name: Route Art
app.description: Turn the routes from your Strava activities into a picture you can download.

sample.title: Try it with sample routes
sample.body: Use a set of sample routes. No sign-in needed.

connect.title: Use your own routes
connect.body: Connect your Strava account to make art from your activities.
connect.permission: Strava will ask you to allow access to your activities. You can choose whether to include private ones.
connect.storage: We keep only each activity's date and route line, and only in this browser. They pass through our server on the way, but we don't store them there.
connect.disconnect: You can disconnect at any time. That removes your activities from this browser and withdraws our access on Strava.
connect.cookie: A sign-in cookie keeps you connected until you close your browser.

connected.title: Your Strava is connected
connected.body: Your activities are ready to use.

errors.denied: You didn't give permission, so nothing was connected. You can try again whenever you like.
errors.scope: To make art from your routes, we need permission to read your activities. Please try again and allow access to your activities.
errors.failed: Something went wrong connecting to Strava. Please try again.
errors.expired: Your Strava connection has ended, so we've removed your activities from this browser. Connect again to keep going.
errors.revoke: You're disconnected here, but we couldn't remove this app from your Strava account. You can remove it yourself in your Strava settings, under My Apps.

studio.title: Your routes

sample.title: Sample routes
sample.body: These are some of the creator's public activities. Only the day of each one is kept, the first and last 500 metres of each route are removed, and on the globe each one shows only as an area about 25 km across.

studio.skipped_one: {{count}} activity in these dates has no map, so it isn't drawn.
studio.skipped_other: {{count}} activities in these dates have no map, so they aren't drawn.
studio.empty: No routes in these dates. Try a wider range.
studio.lowContrast: These two colours are hard to tell apart, so the routes may be hard to see.

errors.title: We couldn't load your activities
errors.failed: Something went wrong talking to Strava. Please try again.
errors.busy_one: Too many requests to Strava right now. Please try again in 1 minute.
errors.busy_other: Too many requests to Strava right now. Please try again in {{count}} minutes.
errors.busyLater: Too many requests to Strava right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

studio.noActivities: There are no activities in your Strava account yet.
studio.pngFailed: We couldn't make the PNG. Try downloading the SVG instead.

artLabel.start_one: 1 route drawn from the middle of the picture.
artLabel.start_other: {{count}} routes drawn from the same starting point, spreading out from the centre.
artLabel.chain_other: {{count}} routes joined end to end, each starting where the one before it finished.
artLabel.globe_one: A globe with 1 dot, for the area of {{routes}} routes, rounded to about 25 km.
artLabel.globe_other: A globe with {{count}} dots, for the areas of {{routes}} routes, rounded to about 25 km.

layout.label: Layout
layout.startHelp: Every route starts in the middle and spreads out from there.
layout.chainHelp: Each route starts where the one before it finished, oldest first, turned so they all fit.
layout.globeHelp: A spinning globe with a dot for each area you've been active in.

studio.shades: Use shades of the line colour
studio.shadesHelp: Newest routes are lightest, oldest are darkest.
studio.hideEnds: Hide where each route starts and finishes (the first and last 500 metres)

privacy.start: Every route starts in the middle, so the lines around it show where you usually set off from.
privacy.chain: Joining routes end to end hides where most of them start, but someone who knows the area may recognise their shapes.
privacy.globe: Dots are rounded to about 25 km and placed at the middle of each route, so the globe shows the areas you go to, not where you start or any exact place.

studio.noMaps: None of the activities in these dates have a map, so there's nothing to draw.

routes.help: Untick a route to leave it out of the picture.
routes.list: Routes in these dates, newest first

studio.allHidden: You've hidden every route in these dates. Tick some in the list to show them.
studio.matchScreen: Fit my screen, for a wallpaper
studio.shareFailed: We couldn't open the share menu. Try Download PNG instead.

wallpaper.mac: To use it as your wallpaper, find it in your Downloads folder, Control-click or right-click it, and choose Set Desktop Picture.
wallpaper.windows: To use it as your wallpaper, open your Downloads folder, right-click it (or press and hold), and choose Set as desktop background.
wallpaper.ios: On iPhone and iPad, downloads go to the Files app. To use it as your wallpaper, use Share or save picture instead and choose Save Image.
wallpaper.android: To use it as your wallpaper, open it from your downloads or photos, and choose Set as wallpaper. The wording varies between phones.
wallpaper.other: To use it as your wallpaper, open your downloads and use your computer's option to set a picture as the desktop background.

shared.ios: If you saved it to Photos, open it there, tap Share, and choose Use as Wallpaper.
shared.android: If you saved it to your photos, open it there and choose Set as wallpaper. The wording varies between phones.

wallpaper.squareHint: This picture is square, so your screen may crop it. Tick Fit my screen for one that fits exactly.

studio.shareNote: Anyone you send the picture to can see the shapes of your routes.

exported.shareReady: Your picture is ready. Tap Share or save picture again to open the share menu.

globe.sampleUnavailable: The globe isn't available for these sample routes, because they don't include any places.
globe.transparent: Transparent background (for putting on a website)
globe.unsupported: This browser can't draw the globe. It needs WebGL, which may be switched off. Try another browser or layout.
globe.shareNote: Anyone you send the picture to can see the areas you've been active in, rounded to about 25 km.
globe.tiltHelp: Higher shows more of the north, lower more of the south. The globe keeps spinning as you tilt it.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
